The residue of $24$ modulo $8$ is the integer $0\le r<8$ such that

$$
24≡r\,(\text{mod}\,8).
$$

**Method 1**

To find the residue $r,$ we need to write $24$ as an integer multiple of $8,$ plus the residue $r.$

We note that $24≡0\,(\text{mod}\,8)$ because

$$
24=3\cdot 8+0.
$$

Therefore, the residue of $24$ modulo $8$ is $0.$

**Method 2**

We can use the subtraction property:

$$
\begin{aligned}24 & ≡24-0 &  & (\text{mod}\,8) \\  & ≡24-3\cdot 8 &  & (\text{mod}\,8) \\  & ≡24-24 &  & (\text{mod}\,8) \\  & ≡0 &  & (\text{mod}\,8)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the residue of $24$ modulo $8$ is $0.$
